After things settled down some, we saw our server walk by with several bundles of napkins. My wife tried to motion for her to come over and she kept walking. NO ONE gave them menus, got them drinks, or anything. I could tell the father was getting upset. He ended up flagging down another guy, who was waiting on tables across from us. That guy (sorry no idea his name), took care of them. We wish he had been our server. He seemed very friendly and on task. When our server did show back up again, she literally dropped our bill off, and walked away again.
